draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for the update — completely understand that getting everyone set up takes a bit of time. Your VAT invoice question is still open with our support team, and they'll follow up in that thread; for reference, a VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the easiest starting point. If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
